result.stdout:
wikidown — maintain an ADO-Wiki-compatible /docs folder

Usage:
  wikidown <command> [--root <path>] [options]

Commands:
  list     [--path /Link/Path]                 list children of a page (or root)
  read     --path /Link/Path                   print page markdown to stdout
  write    --path /Link/Path [--file F | --stdin]  write/overwrite a page
  new      --path /Link/Path [--title T] [--file F | --stdin]  create a page
  move     --from /A --to /B                   rename/move a page (and subpages)
  delete   --path /P [--recursive]             delete a page (and optionally subpages)
  reorder  --folder /P --names a,b,c           rewrite .order for a folder
  search   --query <text> [--case-sensitive]   search all page bodies

Global:
  --root <path>   path to docs folder (default: ./docs)
